Kokoamsɛm ne
website ho nsɛm.

Eyi yɛ website nsiesie foforo ho nhwɛso a ɛde ne ho a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛkyerɛ. Ɛnyɛ adwumakuw no website a ɛyɛ aban de.

Adwumakuw no mfitiase website

Adwumakuw no ho nsɛm, nkitahodi nsɛm ne mfonini fi alsheikhinvestmentgroup.com. Adwumakuw no din, ne ahyɛnsode ne ne mfonini yɛ wɔn a ɛyɛ wɔn dea no agyapade. Yɛsrɛ wo, ne adwumakuw no nni nkitaho tẽẽ na si dwumadi a ɛwɔ hɔ ne ne nhyehyɛe so dua.

Wo abisade ho nsɛm

Abisade krataa no siesie email nkyerɛwee wɔ wo browser mu. Website nsiesie nhwɛso yi nsoma krataa no nsɛm nkɔ server so, na ɛnkora so. Wubetumi abue nkyerɛwee no wɔ wo email app mu anaa akɔpi abisade no. Nkra no kɔ bere a w’ankasa wode fi wo email app mu soma no nkutoo.

Cookies ne nsɛm mu nhwehwɛmu

Website no code mfa nhwehwɛmu anaa dawurubɔ cookies nsi hɔ, na ɛmfa abɔnten nhwehwɛmu dwumadi mma mu. Kokoam website akorae dwumadi no betumi de n’ankasa kwan a wɔfa so kɔ mu ne ahyɛnsode-si-so-dua nhyehyɛe adi dwuma.

Link a ɛkɔ abɔnten

Telefon ne email link bue wo afiri no app ahorow. Asase mfonini link bue Google Maps. Saa dwumadi no de wɔn ankasa kokoamsɛm nhyehyɛe di dwuma.
